Show prints one entry: whether it is available, its tasks, speed, cost,
limits (its notes, and its plan's usage now, or "limits not known"), what
it is good at and what to avoid, who set it, and its notes counted. Then every note on it, oldest first: its task kind, verdict, who
wrote it, the session it cites, what happened and why. A superseded note is
listed, marked, and not counted.

It also shows the notes on a harness and model that have no entry.

--json prints {"host", "key", "entry", "notes": [...]}.

Usage:
  agent roster show HARNESS/MODEL[@EFFORT] [flags]

Examples:
  agent roster show claude/claude-opus-5-5
  agent roster show claude/claude-haiku-5-5@low --json
  agent roster show agy/

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for show
      --json   Print the entry and its notes as one JSON document

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
